tool_summary: Changes a user's password, or with privileges, another user's password or account status.
platform_notes: Core flag set is broadly consistent across GNU/Linux and BSD/macOS passwd for the purposes of this ruleset.

rules.description: The -l/-lock and -d/--delete flags lock an account or remove its password entirely, which can deny access to the account or, on the account's own password, remove authentication protection.
rules.reversible_note: Locking is reversible with -u/--unlock, but deleting a password (-d) is reversible only by setting a new one; either can cause immediate loss of account access.

rules.description: Bare invocation or invocation targeting a specific user changes an authentication credential. This can lock the invoking agent or another user out of the account, or grant the agent knowledge of a new credential.
rules.reversible_note: The password can be changed again, but the interim state (old credential invalid) may cause lockout before a new one is set.
